messages.author: 816fa7be5b21d416
messages.subject: updateInput from pages
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for 0.6 shiny release with action button and other things.
Is updateSelectInput/updateTextInput available on shiny 0.6?

I was using this function on Shiny hosted server. 
But when I am using it on our own Shiny Server it's giving error  could not find function "updateTextInput"
Please advise.

Thanks a lot,
Dipika

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: updateInput from pages
parts:
Yes, they're in 0.6.0. Have you updated Shiny on the server to the
latest version?

Also keep in mind that if the user account holding the app has its own
version of Shiny, the app will use that version of Shiny instead of
the system-wide installation of Shiny.

To find out what version you're using, start up R and run:
packageVersion('shiny')


-Winston

messages.subject: Re: updateInput from pages
parts:
And if you're using Shiny Server in its default configuration then the user that actually launches the Shiny app, is the "shiny" user. So you'll need to install Shiny as root, or as that user. Here's the easy way to install it as root:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
